kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Attacks deal an additional [2 / 4 / 6 + (0.03) × AD[statFormula=2]] true damage, stacking infinitely. Takedowns against champions and epic monsters leave behind a piece of Void Coral.

Active: Bel'Veth consumes a Void Coral, gaining [1] Lavender stack and activating her true form. Void Coral from void epic monsters causes minions that die nearby to become Void Remora. While casting, Bel'Veth Slows nearby enemies before exploding, dealing [150 / 200 / 250 + (1.5) × AP] + [20]% missing-Health true damage.

In her true form, Bel'Veth gains [100 / 250 / 400 + (1.5) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1.5) × AP] max Health, [25 / 75 / 125] Attack range, [(0.06 / 0.13 / 0.2) × 100]% Total Attack Speed, and Void Surge can pass through walls.

True form lasts [45] seconds, increased to [90] seconds at [40] Lavender stacks. At [80] Lavender stacks, true form lasts until death.
